decisions.reason: The accepted stainless-steel whisk selection and superseded whisk style are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting the stainless-steel whisk does not change the dispensing valve, flow, or operating sequence.
The whisk selection is intended to support the existing mixing-quality target but does not change that target.
The selected whisk does not change bowl removal, swapping, or cleaning access requirements.
The source accepts a whisk but does not alter the splash target or splash-guard policy.
The component-selection decision does not necessarily change the current system-layout or CAD-design attributes.
Accepting the proposed whisk is consistent with, but does not modify, the existing V1 sourcing policy.
The whisk selection has no necessary effect on spout geometry, construction, orientation, or beverage-quality constraints.
The accepted mechanical whisk selection does not establish a change to the basic wiring-plan deliverable.
The whisk selection does not change the machine's DJ-style visual identity or render fidelity.
The source decision concerns the whisk and does not change spout cleaning or fluid-path sanitation requirements.
The selected whisk is compatible with the existing bowl choice but does not change bowl capacity or form.
